# Lightweight Charts

Unmodified `lightweight-charts@5.0.0` standalone production bundle, vendored so
the dashboard can load charts without contacting a CDN.

Source: https://unpkg.com/lightweight-charts@5.0.0/dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js

Copyright (c) 2025 TradingView, Inc. Distributed under the Apache 2.0 license
in `lightweight-charts-LICENSE`. The bundle retains its upstream copyright header
and the chart's default TradingView attribution logo/link.
